verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms PagerDuty publishes an llms.txt index at support.pagerduty.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that an agent can be pointed at. Its documentation is also served as machine-readable markdown: .md support pages, raw markdown developer docs, and a public OpenAPI schema. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the llms.txt/markdown docs, and evidence of an llms.txt for the developer.pagerduty.com API docs (only the support knowledge base is shown).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: enables AI assistants (like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or VS Code) to interact securely with your PagerDuty account
